note.what: Every message this realm queued: to whom, which message, and what became of it. A SENT message keeps no body. A dead letter keeps its body until it is retried or retention (mail.retentionS) removes it; Retry sends it again to the address the entry holds now.
captured.heading: The captured message
captured.note: Development only: the capture transport kept it instead of sending it. Links in it work.
noBody: No body is shown: a message that was sent keeps none, and a pending or dead one's is not drawn here.
